summary: In Feralas, Jer'kai Moonweaver sends you to Darnassus with a ring for High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. It will show that Jer'kai and Kindal are well and support your account.

sections.title: A Ring for the High Priestess
sections.body: Jer'kai Moonweaver and Kindal have little to offer in Feralas, yet they want you to know they are grateful. Jer'kai gives you a signet ring for High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The ring shows Tyrande that the pair are well and lends weight to your account.

sections.title: Tyrande's Answer
sections.body: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind is pleased that you helped dragonkind and one of her priestesses. She says Jer'kai was right to send you and promises the ring will be returned to Jer'kai. Scouts are soon to head toward Feralas, with the ring among the matters they will look into.

faq.answer: Jer'kai Moonweaver gives you the signet ring in Feralas, with thanks from Kindal as well.

faq.q: Where does the signet ring go?
aliases: where do I take the ring
faq.answer: The ring goes to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why does Jer'kai give you the ring?
faq.answer: Jer'kai and Kindal have little to give in the wilderness. The ring shows Tyrande they are well and supports your account.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: The chain continues with An Orphan Looking For a Home.
